description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…“Sunset on 30A”, a family-friendly retreat in Seacrest Beach. Enjoy breathtaking Gulf views, a private courtyard, and 2-minute access to a private beach. This laid-back luxury getaway offers access to nearby Beach Front Pool 1-minute away, scenic bike paths with 4 Bikes provided, and the charm of Rosemary Beach with boutique shops and dining. With 3 suites, it's perfect for families or couples. Learn more below… *** HIGHLIGHTS *** Gulf Front Community 1-Min Walk: Cool off or lounge by the pool just steps from your door.Private Beach Access: Exclusive access lets you reach the beach in just 2 minutes.Gulf Views: Relax and enjoy stunning Gulf sunsets from your private balcony.Sleeps 8 Guests: 3 Spacious Suites (2 King and 1 Bunk Room) with beach-inspired decor.Updated Kitchen: Cook with ease in a thoroughly equipped modern kitchen .Private Courtyard: Enjoy outdoor dining and grilling in your own private courtyard.3 Beach Bikes: Explore scenic 30A with four bikes, perfect for nearby trails and beaches.Between Rosemary Beach & Alys: Perfectly located near boutique shopping, dining, and local charm, and just a 1-minute bike ride to Rosemary Beach.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Perfect location just steps from the beach and pool. Planning next year’s trip already!" – Verified Traveler⭐ "Super clean and cozy. Loved being walking distance to everything on 30A!" – Angie R.⭐ "The ultimate family getaway. Bikes, Gulf views, and pool proximity made our trip incredible." – Lisa Y.*** LIVING AREA(S) ***Relax in the breezy, coastal-inspired living room with plush seating, a fireplace, and a Smart TV. Perfect for unwinding after a day at the beach!Open-Concept Living Room with Comfortable SeatingSmart TV for EntertainmentCozy Fireplace for Added Warmth and Ambiance*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, thoughtful amenities and granite countertops, ideal for preparing family meals. Dine together at the cozy table for 4.Fully-Equipped Kitchen with Stainless Steel AppliancesSpacious Granite Countertops for Meal PrepDining Table for 4, plus 2 at the Breakfast BarStandard and Keurig Coffee Makers, Blender for Smoothies and more*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:King Guest Bedroom: 1 King Bed, smart TV, cozy reading chair and en-suite bathroom with tub/shower combo2nd Floor:Primary Suite: 1 King Bed, smart TV, cozy reading chair and en-suite bathroom with tub/shower comboBunk Room: 2 XL Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 4), Private Balcony Access with Gulf Views and En-suite Bathroom with tub/shower combo*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Begin your day with stunning Gulf views, or host a cozy cookout in the serene private courtyard. As evening falls, unwind with breathtaking sunset hues from the comfort of your private balcony.Private Courtyard – Your personal oasis, perfect for unwinding in peace and serenity.Gulf View from 2nd-Floor Balcony – Enjoy partial Gulf views from the balcony, conveniently accessible through the Bunk Room.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Gulf Front Pool access is just a short 1-minute walk away, and the beach is right at your fingertips for endless sunny days by the shore! Plus, you’re perfectly located to explore the vibrant charm of 30A.Private Beach Access – Just a 2-minute walk away for ultimate relaxation and tranquility.Pool Access (1-Minute Away) – Dive into relaxation with a refreshing pool just steps from your door.Rosemary Beach (1-Min Bike Ride) – A charming coastal village with boutique shops, dining, and a laid-back vibe.Alys Beach (8-Min Walk) – Stroll into elegance with iconic white architecture, stunning views, and a sophisticated atmosphere.Peddler’s Pavilion (Seasonal) – Enjoy live music and local nightlife in a lively, upbeat setting.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in quotes but can be added at checkout.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.La Dolce Vida can be contacted for beach chair service. These are NOT included with rental.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 220304STRO #: STR-219504
